title: The Threshold Momentum Cascade: How Left-Digit Change Effect Activates Lay Theories to Drive Premature Selling in Retail Stock Market

detail.title: The Threshold Momentum Cascade: How Left-Digit Change Effect Activates Lay Theories to Drive Premature Selling in Retail Stock Market
detail.abstract: Minor price changes at round-number thresholds (e.g., a stock falling from $5.01 to $4.99) can trigger an immediate and disproportionate selling reaction when the slope crosses a round number. This study introduces the "Threshold Momentum Cascade," a new conceptual framework that explains how this perceptual cue drives trading behavior. This framework demonstrates that the left-digit change acts as an amplifier, activating a potent, nonfundamental signal that triggers an intuitive lay belief of downward momentum in inexperienced traders. We propose that this activated belief, rather than the price change itself, mediates the relationship between the threshold crossing and premature selling. Furthermore, this effect is moderated by individual traits: fear and overconfidence amplify the effect, whereas trading experience attenuates it by promoting reflective processing. By formalizing how a perceptual bias can trigger a behavioral cascade, our framework explains market overreactions to trivial price movements and suggests practical interventions, such as redesigning price displays and enhancing financial literacy to protect vulnerable investors. It thus bridges marketing research on price perception with behavioral finance, offering a new, testable proposition for theory and practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"阈值动量级联"框架，解释股票价格跨越整数关口(如从$5.01跌至$4.99)时引发的非理性抛售行为。研究发现，这种左位数变化作为放大器，激活非基本面信号，触发新手交易者对下行动量的直觉信念，进而导致过早卖出。个体特质(恐惧、过度自信)会放大该效应，而交易经验通过促进反思处理来减弱该效应。
AI.research_question: 为什么微小的价格变化跨越整数关口(如从$5.01跌至$4.99)会引发不成比例的抛售反应？这种感知线索如何驱动交易行为？
AI.motivation: 市场对微小价格变动存在过度反应现象，特别是当价格跨越整数阈值时。这种现象在行为金融学中尚未得到充分解释，需要将营销学中的价格感知研究与行为金融学相结合，理解这种非理性交易行为的心理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值动量级联框架：左位数变化作为放大器→激活非基本面信号→触发直觉性动量信念→导致过早卖出。该框架整合了价格感知理论、行为金融学中的认知偏差理论，以及双系统思维理论(直觉vs反思处理)。
AI.method: 论文未明确说明具体研究方法，但从内容推断可能采用实验研究、交易数据分析或混合方法，通过检验阈值跨越与抛售行为的关系，并考察个体特质(恐惧、过度自信、交易经验)的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1) 价格跨越整数阈值会引发不成比例的抛售反应；2) 这种效应由激活的动量信念中介，而非价格变化本身；3) 恐惧和过度自信会放大该效应；4) 交易经验通过促进反思处理来减弱该效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"阈值动量级联"新概念框架；2) 将营销学的价格感知研究与行为金融学连接；3) 形式化感知偏差如何触发行为级联；4) 提供可检验的理论命题；5) 解释市场对微小价格变动的过度反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议重新设计价格显示方式；2) 增强金融素养教育以保护弱势投资者；3) 为监管机构和金融机构提供干预措施；4) 帮助投资者识别和避免非理性交易行为。

title: Evaluating Recruitment Robustness: A Multi-Dimensional Ranking Framework Using Type-Reduced q-Rung Orthopair Fuzzy Sets for High-Variance Talent Pools

detail.title: Evaluating Recruitment Robustness: A Multi-Dimensional Ranking Framework Using Type-Reduced q-Rung Orthopair Fuzzy Sets for High-Variance Talent Pools

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of LayersRank a platform developed by The Algorithm (the-algo.com), the platform described and evaluated in this research. This study was conducted to validate the mathematical framework underpinning the production system. The author holds intellectual property rights related to the TR-q-ROFN implementation and adaptive questioning methodology discussed herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilized a programmatically generated synthetic dataset of 120,000+ candidate profiles to evaluate model robustness. Because the research did not involve human participants, patients, or personally identifiable information (PII), formal Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was not required. declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and supported by the internal resources of The Algorithm/LayersRank. No external grants from government agencies, charitable foundations, or private venture capital were utilized in the generation of the reported data or the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: High-volume recruitment suffers from a fundamental precision gap: traditional scoring methods-whether binary filters, linear weighted averages, or neural network classifiers-produce candidate rankings without quantifying how confident those rankings are. A candidate scored 78/100 might reflect genuine competence or deep measurement uncertainty, and the recruiter cannot tell which. This paper introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that addresses this gap by separating two concerns: scoring (how good is this candidate?) and uncertainty detection (how sure are we?). We employ Type-Reduced q-Rung Orthopair Fuzzy Numbers (TR-q-ROFNs) with q=2 not to produce scores, but to compute a refusal degree (R) that quantifies inter-scorer disagreement across four independent evaluation models. When R exceeds a calibrated threshold, an adaptive questioning layer generates targeted follow-up questions to resolve ambiguity during the interview itself-before any report reaches the recruiter. We validate this approach on a dataset of 10,000 candidate profiles spanning 26 Indian cities, 8 institution tiers, and 4 socioeconomic bands. Results demonstrate that the adaptive layer reduces confidence variance by 73% compared to static assessment methods, ensuring that every reported score meets a minimum confidence threshold. The framework is implemented as LayersRank, a production system currently evaluating candidates across technical, behavioral, and contextual dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LayersRank系统，通过TR-q-ROFNs计算拒绝度(R)来量化评分者分歧，当R超过阈值时触发自适应提问层，在面试中解决不确定性，相比静态方法减少73%置信度方差。
AI.research_question: 如何在高容量招聘中解决传统评分方法无法量化排名置信度的问题？如何通过不确定性检测和自适应提问来确保报告分数的可靠性？
AI.motivation: 传统招聘评分方法（二元筛选、线性加权平均、神经网络分类器）产生候选人排名时无法量化这些排名的置信度，招聘者无法区分高分是真实能力还是测量不确定性，存在根本性的精确度差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Type-Reduced q-Rung Orthopair Fuzzy Numbers (TR-q-ROFNs)理论，采用q=2参数，通过计算拒绝度(R)来量化四个独立评估模型之间的评分者分歧。
AI.method: 使用TR-q-ROFNs计算拒绝度(R)，当R超过校准阈值时触发自适应提问层生成针对性后续问题；在包含10,000个候选人档案的数据集上进行验证，涵盖26个印度城市、8个机构层级和4个社会经济阶层。
AI.findings: 自适应提问层相比静态评估方法减少73%的置信度方差，确保每个报告分数都满足最低置信阈值；系统已实现为LayersRank生产系统，评估技术、行为和情境三个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出将评分（候选人有多好）与不确定性检测（我们有多确定）分离的多维评估框架；2) 创新性地将TR-q-ROFNs应用于量化评分者分歧而非产生分数；3) 建立拒绝度(R)作为不确定性度量的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发LayersRank生产系统，已在真实招聘环境中部署；2) 提供自适应提问机制，在面试过程中实时解决不确定性；3) 为高容量招聘提供可量化的置信度保证，减少误判风险。

title: Optimal Production of Remanufactured Products With Collaboration and Co-Branding of Luxury Brands
affiliations: University of Tehran, University of Tehran and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: Optimal Production of Remanufactured Products With Collaboration and Co-Branding of Luxury Brands

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Remanufactured products belong to the category of environmentally friendly products. Here, we develop models and strategies for collaborating and co-branding of luxury brands with other companies for producing remanufactured products of luxury brands. Then, we examine whether the strategies can coordinate them for producing remanufactured products or not, because of small market share of luxury brands, they should co-brand with a company which has large market share for expanding the market share and selling the remanufactured product. We use a specific name for a brand of remanufactured product because of preventing change of viewpoint of customers to the luxury brand and avoiding brand switching. Producing a new type product should not hurt the status of the luxury brand. Thus, all the possible circumstances should be considered in the process of introduction of a new brand. After development of remanufactured products, we describe different ways and models of advertising for expanding sales by employing differential game models. Overall, we describe the complete activities that are necessary for development of a new brand. As a specific case, we choose the production of remanufactured products by luxury brands which can be a new subject for future research. We find expansion of luxury brand's market share a new issue. Moreover, producing remanufactured and environmentally friendly products with secondhand materials by luxury brands is a new subject. In the last part, we perform sensitive analysis to examine the effect of parameters on decision variables and presenting managerial insights.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究奢侈品牌如何通过与其他公司合作生产再制造产品来扩大市场份额，同时保护品牌形象。作者开发了合作与联合品牌策略模型，并分析这些策略是否能协调各方生产再制造产品。
AI.research_question: 奢侈品牌如何通过与其他公司合作生产再制造产品来扩大市场份额，同时保护品牌形象和地位？
AI.motivation: 奢侈品牌市场份额较小，需要通过生产环保的再制造产品来扩大市场，但需要避免损害品牌形象和地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合作与联合品牌理论、品牌管理理论、再制造产品营销理论、微分博弈模型
AI.method: 开发合作与联合品牌策略模型，使用微分博弈模型分析广告策略，进行敏感性分析
AI.findings: 奢侈品牌需要与市场份额大的公司合作生产再制造产品；应为再制造产品使用特定品牌名称以避免损害奢侈品牌形象；广告策略对扩大销售很重要
AI.theory_contributions: 为奢侈品牌再制造产品开发了合作与联合品牌策略框架；提出了保护奢侈品牌形象的品牌管理方法；扩展了微分博弈在再制造产品营销中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品牌提供了生产再制造产品的具体合作策略；提供了保护品牌形象的品牌命名建议；给出了通过广告扩大销售的实际方法

title: How Paywall Suspensions Expand Digital Access: Evidence from Branded News App Downloads

detail.title: How Paywall Suspensions Expand Digital Access: Evidence from Branded News App Downloads
detail.abstract: Newspapers suspend paywalls during major news events to ensure public access to vital information. Yet, the policy implications of such suspensions for digital equity and news access remain underexplored. This study investigates whether and under what conditions temporary paywall removals can enhance the adoption of branded mobile news apps-a durable and potentially more inclusive form of digital engagement. Using 6,396 daily news app download observations across 25 paywall suspensions by 12 U.S. newspapers during 13 significant events, we estimate the heterogeneous and time-varying effects of paywall suspensions through a Bayesian panel causal inference framework. We find that paywall suspension increases app downloads substantially. The impact varies, however, with greater effects for more important news events, newspapers with larger audiences, and geographically relevant suspensions. Importantly, the effectiveness of geo-relevant suspensions depends on the newspaper audience size: they significantly boost app downloads for smaller newspapers but have little effect for larger ones. This pattern suggests that small newspapers benefit more from locally targeted access policies, likely because they rely more on geographic proximity to build digital readership. Our findings have implications for both policymakers concerned with digital access and publishers making strategic paywall suspension decisions during critical events.

AI.tldr: 研究美国报纸在重大新闻事件期间暂停付费墙对移动新闻应用下载的影响，发现暂停付费墙能显著增加应用下载，效果因事件重要性、报纸受众规模和地理相关性而异。
AI.research_question: 临时付费墙暂停是否以及在什么条件下能够促进品牌移动新闻应用的采用？
AI.motivation: 报纸在重大新闻事件期间暂停付费墙以确保公众获取重要信息，但这种政策对数字公平和新闻获取的影响尚未充分研究，特别是对移动新闻应用这种更持久、更具包容性的数字参与形式的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字公平理论、新闻获取理论、移动应用采用理论、地理相关性理论、受众规模与媒体效果理论
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯面板因果推断框架，分析12家美国报纸在13个重大事件期间的25次付费墙暂停，涵盖6,396个每日新闻应用下载观察数据
AI.findings: 1. 付费墙暂停显著增加应用下载量；2. 效果具有异质性和时变性；3. 更重要的新闻事件效果更大；4. 受众规模更大的报纸效果更大；5. 地理相关的暂停效果取决于报纸规模：对小报纸显著提升下载量，对大报纸影响有限
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究付费墙暂停对移动新闻应用采用的影响；2. 揭示地理相关性与报纸规模在数字访问政策效果中的交互作用；3. 为数字公平和新闻获取理论提供实证证据；4. 提出小报纸更依赖地理邻近性建立数字读者群的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为关注数字访问的政策制定者提供决策依据；2. 为出版商在关键事件期间制定战略性的付费墙暂停决策提供指导；3. 帮助小报纸通过本地化访问政策更有效地建立数字读者群；4. 优化新闻机构在紧急事件中的信息传播策略

title: Cutting the Hand Instead of the Finger: Privacy, Intermediary Liability, and Doctrinal Drift in Falana v. Meta.
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - School of Law, Babcock University - School of Law and Security Studies

detail.title: Cutting the Hand Instead of the Finger: Privacy, Intermediary Liability, and Doctrinal Drift in Falana v. Meta.

contentType.other: Just written to add to the knowledge base on privacy law in Nigeria. No other publication has been made anywhere. This is also not a conference paper.

detail.abstract:
This article critically examines the Lagos State High Court’s decision in Falana v. Meta Platforms Inc, which recharacterizes a third-party false publication as actionable informational privacy harm under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA), and imposes joint controller liability on a hosting platform. Although symbolically significant, the judgment reflects what this article terms judicial syncretism, i.e., the blending of privacy, tort, and agency principles into a composite liability model insufficiently anchored in statutory architecture.

The decision collapses processing into authorship, monetization into purpose determination, and facilitation into agency representation, while attenuating Section 51’s requirement of demonstrable injury resulting from a statutory violation. Drawing on comparative data protection jurisprudence, and orthodox intermediary liability frameworks, the article argues that the judgment risks transforming privacy law into de facto strict platform liability.

Anchored in the Yoruba maxim “Ìka tó bá ṣe, l’ọba ń gé”, it is the offending finger that the king cuts, the article calls for appellate clarification to preserve doctrinal coherence, and institutional durability in Nigeria’s developing privacy jurisprudence.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析拉各斯州高等法院在Falana诉Meta Platforms Inc案中的判决，该判决将第三方虚假发布重新定性为尼日利亚《2023年数据保护法》下的可诉信息隐私损害，并对托管平台施加联合控制者责任。文章认为该判决体现了"司法融合主义"，即隐私、侵权和代理原则的混合，形成了缺乏法定架构支撑的复合责任模型。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚拉各斯州高等法院在Falana诉Meta Platforms Inc案中的判决如何通过"司法融合主义"重塑数据隐私责任框架，以及这种重构对尼日利亚新兴隐私法理学的潜在影响？
AI.motivation: 该判决虽然具有象征意义，但将处理等同于作者身份、货币化等同于目的确定、便利等同于代理代表，同时削弱了第51条关于法定违规需造成可证明损害的要求。文章担忧这种司法融合主义可能将隐私法转变为事实上的严格平台责任，威胁尼日利亚发展中的隐私法理学的教义一致性和制度持久性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 司法融合主义理论：隐私、侵权和代理原则的混合
2. 比较数据保护法理学
3. 传统中介责任框架
4. 联合控制者责任理论
5. 尼日利亚《2023年数据保护法》的法定架构
AI.method:
1. 批判性法律分析：对Falana诉Meta Platforms Inc案判决的深入解析
2. 比较法研究：借鉴国际数据保护法理学
3. 教义分析：评估判决与尼日利亚《2023年数据保护法》法定架构的一致性
4. 概念重构：识别判决中的概念混淆（处理/作者身份、货币化/目的确定、便利/代理代表）
AI.findings:
1. 判决通过"司法融合主义"创造了复合责任模型
2. 将第三方虚假发布重新定性为信息隐私损害
3. 对托管平台施加联合控制者责任
4. 削弱了法定损害要求，可能建立事实上的严格责任
5. 威胁尼日利亚隐私法理学的教义一致性和制度发展
AI.theory_contributions:

2. 识别数据保护法中的概念混淆模式
3. 为新兴法域的数据隐私法理学发展提供理论框架
4. 贡献于平台责任与隐私保护平衡的理论讨论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 呼吁上诉法院澄清以维护教义一致性
2. 为尼日利亚法院提供避免过度扩张平台责任的指导

title: Beyond Search: LLM Adoption and Web Traffic Concentration
affiliations: , Cornell University - Cornell University, College of Computing and Information Science (CIS), Department of Information Science, Students, Cornell  University,  Ithaca,  New  York and Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Beyond Search: LLM Adoption and Web Traffic Concentration

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved under Carnegie Mellon University’s IRB protocol STUDY2017_00000297, last modified (and approved) on 9/5/2025.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Carnegie Mellon University Block Center for Technology and Society, Carnegie Mellon University CyLab Security and Privacy Institute, the Institute of Humane Studies and the Program on the Economics & Privacy at George Mason University, the University of Pennsylvania Center for Technology, Innovation and Competition and the Warren Center for Network & Data Sciences, the Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center, the NET Institute, the Cornell Center for Social Sciences, and the National Science Foundation (awards 2237327/2237328/2237329)

detail.abstract: Search engines have long served as the primary gateway to the web, dispersing user attention across a wide range of external websites. The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs), which provide answers directly within platform interfaces, raises concerns that online activity may become more centralized. We study whether LLM adoption displaces traditional web navigation or instead restructures how users discover and consume information. Using nationally representative Comscore panel data from 2019-2024 and session-level evidence from a field experiment about online behaviors led by a northeastern university, we examine how search activity, web exploration, and downstream navigation evolve with LLM use. Exploiting staggered adoption across users, we find that LLM adoption coincides with a sustained increase in the number of unique websites visited, alongside a short-lived rise in traditional search activity, suggesting that LLMs can complement rather than replace search. Session-level analyses show that most LLM use occurs alongside search, while LLM-only sessions remain rare. Moreover, when LLMs do route users to external websites, the resulting traffic is no more concentrated than traffic generated by traditional search.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型（LLMs）的采用并未取代传统网络搜索，而是作为补充工具增加了用户访问的网站数量，且LLM生成的流量集中度与传统搜索相似。
AI.research_question: LLM的采用是否会取代传统的网络导航，还是会重构用户发现和消费信息的方式？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在平台界面直接提供答案的快速普及，人们担心在线活动可能变得更加集中化，需要研究LLMs对网络导航模式的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息搜索理论、平台集中化理论、用户行为模式理论
AI.method: 使用2019-2024年全国代表性的Comscore面板数据，以及东北大学主导的在线行为现场实验的会话级证据，采用交错采用设计分析搜索活动、网络探索和下游导航的演变。
AI.findings: 1. LLM采用与访问独特网站数量的持续增加相关；2. 传统搜索活动短暂上升；3. 大多数LLM使用与搜索同时发生；4. LLM-only会话很少见；5. LLM引导的外部网站流量集中度与传统搜索相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了LLMs会导致网络集中化的假设，提出了LLMs作为搜索补充而非替代的理论框架，为理解新技术如何重构而非取代现有信息获取模式提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为搜索引擎公司、内容提供商和政策制定者提供实证依据，表明LLMs可能促进更广泛的网络探索而非集中化，有助于制定更平衡的技术采用策略。

title: Towards Robust Federated Intrusion Detection Comparative Analysis of FL Topologies under Poisoning Attacks
affiliations: Ravensbourne University London, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Sejong University

detail.title: Towards Robust Federated Intrusion Detection Comparative Analysis of FL Topologies under Poisoning Attacks
detail.abstract: The increasing scale and heterogeneity of distributed Internet of Things (IoT) and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) environments demand intrusion detection systems (IDS) that are accurate, communication-efficient, and resilient to adversarial manipulation. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative IDS training without direct data sharing; however, the communication topology and training protocol can significantly affect both efficiency and robustness under attack. This paper presents an empirical evaluation of four FL topologies Federated Averaging (FedAvg), Federated Cyclic Weight Transfer Learning (FCWTL), Gossip FL, and Ring FL for intrusion detection under non-IID client data distributions. The study considers two poisoning threats, label-flipping and Gaussian noise based model perturbation, under adversary ratios of 20% and 40%.We compare the investigated topologies in terms of detection performance, convergence behavior, and communication overhead, highlighting robustness efficiency trade-offs across three benchmark datasets. The results provide practical insights for selecting FL strategies for security-critical IoT/IoMT deployments where both adversarial resilience and resource constraints must be jointly considered.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究比较了四种联邦学习拓扑结构（FedAvg、FCWTL、Gossip FL、Ring FL）在非独立同分布数据下的入侵检测性能，评估了它们在标签翻转和高斯噪声攻击下的鲁棒性、收敛行为和通信开销，为安全关键的IoT/IoMT部署提供了策略选择指导。
AI.research_question: 不同联邦学习拓扑结构（FedAvg、FCWTL、Gossip FL、Ring FL）在非独立同分布数据下对入侵检测系统的准确性、通信效率和对抗攻击鲁棒性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 分布式IoT/IoMT环境的规模和异构性日益增长，需要准确、通信高效且能抵抗对抗攻击的入侵检测系统。联邦学习虽然支持协作训练而不共享数据，但其通信拓扑和训练协议在攻击下的效率和鲁棒性影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦学习理论框架，研究不同拓扑结构（中心化FedAvg、循环权重转移FCWTL、去中心化Gossip FL和Ring FL）在对抗攻击下的性能差异，关注通信效率与鲁棒性的权衡。
AI.method: 采用实证评估方法，在三种基准数据集上比较四种FL拓扑结构，考虑非独立同分布客户端数据分布，测试两种投毒威胁（标签翻转和高斯噪声模型扰动），攻击者比例为20%和40%，评估检测性能、收敛行为和通信开销。
AI.findings: 不同FL拓扑结构在检测性能、收敛速度和通信开销方面存在显著差异，某些拓扑在特定攻击类型下表现更鲁棒，揭示了鲁棒性与效率之间的权衡关系，为不同安全需求的IoT/IoMT部署提供了选择依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对联邦学习拓扑结构在对抗攻击下性能差异的理论理解，揭示了不同拓扑在非独立同分布数据下的鲁棒性机制，为联邦学习安全理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安全关键的IoT/IoMT部署提供了具体的FL策略选择指导，帮助系统设计者在对抗弹性和资源约束之间做出平衡决策，优化入侵检测系统的实际部署效果。

title: The Impact of Closed-Loop Medication Management Systems on Patient Safety and User Experience: A Pre-Post Mixed-Methods Study
affiliations: Monash Health, Monash Health, Monash Health and Monash Health

detail.title: The Impact of Closed-Loop Medication Management Systems on Patient Safety and User Experience: A Pre-Post Mixed-Methods Study
detail.abstract: BackgroundDigital medication systems such as implementation of Closed Loop Medication Management Systems has the potential to enhance patient safety in healthcare services.ObjectivesThe primary objective of this study was to assess the change in reported medication errors per 1000 bed encounters following implementation of Closed Loop Medication Management Systems in a new, specialist, fully digitised Australian Hospital. Secondary objectives included: evaluating user satisfaction; identifying workflow challenges; and collecting suggestions for system improvements.MethodsA pre-post, mixed-methods design combined cross-sectional and qualitative descriptive methods. The study was conducted before and after moving staff and patients to a 200-bed fully digitised cardiac hospital (December 2021–July 2022 and May–December 2023). Medication error data were extracted from the hospital’s incident management system, and a cross-sectional anonymous survey was distributed to nursing staff. Descriptive statistics and thematic analysis were used.ResultsPost-implementation, reported medication errors significantly decreased from 0.5 to 0.1 per 1000 bed encounters (p=0.02). Among 39 survey respondents, 67% believed Closed Loop Medication Management Systems improved patient safety compared to traditional methods. However, only 22% reported improved workflow efficiency. While 60% of nurses received formal training, 55% still experienced difficulties navigating the system. Notably, 63% of respondents had 10 years or less of nursing experience.ConclusionImplementation of a Closed Loop Medication Management System led to a significant reduction in medication errors and was positively perceived in terms of patient safety. However, challenges in system usability and workflow integration remain. Addressing these issues through enhanced training and system refinement is essential to maximise the benefits of the technology and acceptability by nurses.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了闭环药物管理系统在澳大利亚一家专科医院实施后的效果，发现药物错误显著减少，但系统可用性和工作流程整合仍存在挑战。
AI.research_question: 闭环药物管理系统的实施如何影响药物错误报告率、用户满意度、工作流程挑战以及系统改进建议？
AI.motivation: 数字药物系统如闭环药物管理系统有潜力提升医疗服务中的患者安全，但需要实证评估其实际效果和用户体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗信息技术采纳理论、患者安全框架、工作流程整合理论
AI.method: 采用前后混合方法设计，结合横断面调查和定性描述方法。研究在澳大利亚一家200床位的全数字化心脏专科医院进行（2021年12月-2022年7月和2023年5月-12月）。从医院事件管理系统提取药物错误数据，并向护理人员分发匿名横断面调查。使用描述性统计和主题分析。
AI.findings: 实施后，报告的药物错误从每1000床位遭遇0.5次显著减少到0.1次（p=0.02）。67%的受访者认为系统比传统方法改善了患者安全，但只有22%报告工作流程效率提高。55%的护士在使用系统时遇到困难，尽管60%接受了正式培训。63%的受访者拥有10年或更少的护理经验。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗信息技术采纳理论提供了实证支持，表明技术实施确实能减少药物错误，但用户接受度和工作流程整合是关键调节因素。揭示了经验水平与系统使用困难之间的潜在关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者提供了实施闭环药物管理系统的实际效果数据，强调了加强培训和系统改进的重要性。为系统开发者提供了用户反馈，指出了可用性改进方向。为政策制定者提供了数字医疗技术投资的实证依据。

title: Market Inefficiency in Cryptoasset Markets
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Department of Finance, Ethereum Foundation, University of Florida and Ethereum Foundation

detail.title: Market Inefficiency in Cryptoasset Markets
detail.abstract: We demonstrate market inefficiency in cryptoasset markets. Our approach examines investments that share a dominant risk factor but differ in their exposure to a secondary risk. We derive equilibrium restrictions that must hold regardless of how investors price either risk. Our empirical results strongly reject these necessary equilibrium restrictions. The rejection implies market inefficiency that cannot be attributed to mispriced risk, suggesting the presence of frictions that impede capital reallocation.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析共享主要风险因子但次要风险暴露不同的加密资产投资组合，发现了市场无效性证据，这种无效性无法用风险定价错误解释，表明存在阻碍资本重新配置的摩擦
AI.research_question: 加密资产市场是否存在市场无效性？这种无效性是否可以归因于风险定价错误？
AI.motivation: 加密资产市场作为新兴金融市场，其效率性备受关注。传统金融市场效率研究主要关注风险定价，但加密市场可能存在独特的摩擦因素阻碍资本有效配置
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、资产定价理论、均衡限制条件分析框架
AI.method: 构建共享主要风险因子但次要风险暴露不同的投资组合，推导无论投资者如何定价风险都必须满足的均衡限制条件，进行实证检验
AI.findings: 实证结果强烈拒绝均衡限制条件，表明市场无效性存在；这种无效性无法归因于风险定价错误，暗示存在阻碍资本重新配置的摩擦
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了检验市场无效性的新方法，区分了风险定价错误与市场摩擦导致的无效性，为理解加密资产市场效率提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密资产投资者识别市场无效性机会提供方法，为监管机构理解市场摩擦提供依据，有助于改善加密资产市场效率

title: Merton's Problem with Recursive Perturbed Utility
affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Tongji University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering & Engineering Management and Columbia University - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research (IEOR)

detail.title: Merton's Problem with Recursive Perturbed Utility
detail.abstract: The classical Merton investment problem predicts deterministic, state-dependent portfolio rules; however, laboratory and field evidence suggests that individuals often prefer randomized decisions leading to stochastic and noisy choices. Fudenberg et al. (2015) develop the additive perturbed utility theory to explain the preference for randomization in the static setting, which, however, becomes ill-posed or intractable in the dynamic setting. We introduce the recursive perturbed utility (RPU), a special stochastic differential utility that incorporates an entropy-based preference for randomization into a recursive aggregator. RPU endogenizes the intertemporal trade-off between utilities from randomization and bequest via a discounting term dependent on past accumulated randomization, thereby avoiding excessive randomization and yielding a well-posed problem. In a general Markovian incomplete market with CRRA preferences, we prove that the RPU-optimal portfolio policy (in terms of the risk exposure ratio) is Gaussian and can be expressed in closed form, independent of wealth. Its variance is inversely proportional to risk aversion and stock volatility, while its mean is based on the solution to a partial differential equation. Moreover, the mean is the sum of a myopic term and an intertemporal hedging term (against market incompleteness) that intertwines with policy randomization. Finally, we carry out an asymptotic expansion in terms of the perturbed utility weight to show that the optimal mean policy deviates from the classical Merton policy at first order, while the associated relative wealth loss is of a higher order, quantifying the financial cost of the preference for randomization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了递归扰动效用（RPU）理论，将随机化偏好纳入动态投资决策，解决了经典Merton模型无法解释随机化投资行为的问题，并推导出高斯分布的最优投资策略。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态投资决策中建模个体的随机化偏好，并推导出相应的最优投资策略？
AI.motivation: 经典Merton投资模型预测确定性的投资规则，但实验和实地证据表明个体偏好随机化决策。现有静态扰动效用理论在动态环境中不适用或难以处理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归扰动效用（RPU）理论，基于熵的随机化偏好，结合随机微分效用，通过依赖过去累积随机化的贴现项内生化随机化与遗产效用的跨期权衡。
AI.method: 在一般马尔可夫不完全市场中，采用CRRA偏好，推导RPU最优投资策略的闭式解，并进行渐近展开分析。
AI.findings: RPU最优投资策略（风险暴露比）呈高斯分布，与财富无关；方差与风险厌恶和股票波动率成反比；均值包含近视项和跨期对冲项；最优均值策略与经典Merton策略在一阶偏离，相关财富损失为高阶。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个适用于动态环境的随机化偏好理论框架（RPU），解决了静态扰动效用理论在动态环境中的不适定性问题，为行为金融学提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解实际投资行为中的随机化偏好提供了理论解释，量化了随机化偏好的财务成本，为投资顾问和资产管理提供了新的决策框架。

title: A Digital Twin-based Approach for Energy Optimisation in Medical Gas Systems in Hospital Intensive Care Units
affiliations: Manisa Celal Bayar University and Health Sciences University (Izmir)

detail.title: A Digital Twin-based Approach for Energy Optimisation in Medical Gas Systems in Hospital Intensive Care Units
detail.abstract: Given the increasing energy demands associated with the use of advanced medical technologies in healthcare services, it has become imperative to implement energy optimisation measures in line with global trends. New technologies such as digital twins, system information modelling, the Internet of Things, sensing technologies, and data analytics have become indispensable elements in creating more efficient systems. This study presents analyses using a digital twin-based approach to ensure energy efficiency in medical gas systems through predictive demand control in hospital intensive care units. Within the scope of the study, a digital twin was developed by simulating operational dynamics, taking into account the physical system model, operational dynamics modelling, and control-optimisation modelling. The time series data generated by the modelled digital twin simulation was used to train an LSTM deep learning model that predicts with 99.5% R2 accuracy. The model, implemented through the digital twin simulation, proactively optimises the operating strategy of the medical compressor system using predictions generated by the developed predictive demand control (PDC) algorithm. The use of the created PDC simulation resulted in an 18.8% energy saving in annual energy consumption compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, there was a 32% improvement in compressor on-off cycles compared to traditional methods. As an advanced approach to system optimisation, the Cycle-Limited Predictive Demand Control (CL-PDC) algorithm was developed by imposing a maximum limit of 10 start-stop cycles per day. This demand cycle resulted in a 13.2% reduction in cycles, 6.0% additional savings, and a +2.5-year extension in contactor life. In the study, the data production process was created by adhering to patient admissions and discharges to the ICU, changes in patient status, and medical gas demand, while also prioritising patient safety. The research draws attention to the energy efficiency and operational digital twin concept and its potential, particularly in hospital infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用数字孪生技术，结合LSTM深度学习模型和预测需求控制算法，优化医院ICU医疗气体系统的能源效率，实现18.8%的年能耗节约和32%的压缩机启停改善。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数字孪生技术和预测需求控制算法优化医院ICU医疗气体系统的能源效率？
AI.motivation: 医疗技术进步带来的能源需求增加，需要实施能源优化措施；数字孪生、物联网、数据分折等新技术为创建更高效系统提供了可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生理论、系统信息建模、物联网技术、深度学习（LSTM模型）、预测需求控制算法、能源优化理论。
AI.method: 开发数字孪生模拟系统（包含物理系统模型、运行动态建模、控制优化建模），使用生成的时序数据训练LSTM深度学习模型，实施预测需求控制算法，并开发循环限制预测需求控制算法。
AI.findings: LSTM模型预测准确率达99.5% R2；PDC算法实现18.8%年能耗节约和32%压缩机启停改善；CL-PDC算法进一步减少13.2%循环次数、增加6.0%节能、延长接触器寿命2.5年。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了医疗气体系统数字孪生建模框架；开发了预测需求控制算法和循环限制预测需求控制算法；验证了深度学习在医疗系统能源优化中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院ICU医疗气体系统提供了可实施的能源优化方案；显著降低能耗和运维成本；延长设备寿命；确保患者安全前提下实现系统优化。

title: Organizational Leadership through Financial Contracting: An OB and Leadership Assessment in its Micro and Macro-Level Dimension

detail.title: Organizational Leadership through Financial Contracting: An OB and Leadership Assessment in its Micro and Macro-Level Dimension
detail.abstract: The following paper assesses strategic consulting in financial contracting from a micro-level and macro-level applicational lense. While the micro-level consultancy is characterized by more individual psychological factors vis-à-vis clients in C-level or VP-level, the macro-level consultancy can be described as a mechanism that values collective psychological circumstances in business dynamics. Together they can appreciate consulting services like contracting advisory as external leadership practice which is explicated in the synthesis of both consulting dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文从微观和宏观两个层面评估金融合同中的战略咨询。微观咨询关注个体心理因素（如C级或VP级客户），宏观咨询则重视商业动态中的集体心理环境。两者结合将咨询服务（如合同咨询）视为外部领导实践。
AI.research_question: 金融合同中的战略咨询如何在微观和宏观两个层面运作？微观咨询（个体心理因素）和宏观咨询（集体心理环境）如何共同构成外部领导实践？
AI.motivation: 理解战略咨询在金融合同中的双重作用：既要关注个体决策者的心理因素，也要考虑组织层面的集体心理环境，从而更全面地认识咨询作为外部领导实践的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观层面：个体心理学理论（关注C级/VP级决策者的心理因素）；宏观层面：集体心理学和组织动力学理论；整合框架：外部领导实践理论。
AI.method: 未明确说明具体方法，但暗示采用多层次分析框架，结合微观（个体）和宏观（集体）两个层面的应用视角进行评估。
AI.findings: 战略咨询在金融合同中具有双重维度：微观咨询关注个体心理因素，宏观咨询关注集体心理环境。两者结合使咨询服务（如合同咨询）能够作为有效的外部领导实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融合同咨询的双层理论框架，整合了微观心理学和宏观组织动力学，将咨询服务概念化为外部领导实践的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为咨询从业者提供了同时考虑个体决策者心理和组织集体心理的双重策略框架，帮助提升金融合同咨询的效果和价值。

title: Entropy as an A Priori Indicator of Forecastability

detail.title: Entropy as an A Priori Indicator of Forecastability
detail.abstract: The ability to accurately determine the a priori forecastability of a time series is an important endeavour for forecasting practitioners as it provides guidance on the potential for accurate forecasts and the associated degree of effort that is warranted. Measures of entropy, such as sample entropy, provide an assessment of the regularity or similarity within a time series. We posit that series with low in-sample entropy, i.e. high regularity, will positively correlate with low out-of-sample forecast error, as measured by the mean absolute scaled error (MASE). To assess this we adopt the 3003 time series used in the M3 forecasting competition spanning micro, industry, macro, finance, and demographic series. We calculate the in-sample sample entropy and out-of-sample MASE for all 3003 series using a common univariate forecasting method. We demonstrate that the a priori sample entropy is indeed a useful predictor of out-of-sample forecast performance, subject to the well-researched problem of structural breaks. We recommend that forecasting practitioners adopt such entropy measures, alongside well-established tests for seasonality and trend, to better understand the likelihood of successful forecasting outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨时间序列样本熵与预测性能的关系，发现样本熵能有效预测样本外预测误差，建议预测从业者将熵度量与季节性和趋势测试结合使用。
AI.research_question: 时间序列的样本熵（衡量序列规律性的指标）是否能够预测样本外预测误差？
AI.motivation: 准确评估时间序列的先验可预测性对预测从业者很重要，因为它能指导预测准确性的潜力和所需的努力程度。现有熵度量（如样本熵）能评估时间序列的规律性，但需要实证验证其与预测性能的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息熵理论，特别是样本熵作为时间序列规律性的度量。假设样本内熵低（规律性高）与样本外预测误差低正相关。
AI.method: 使用M3预测竞赛的3003个时间序列（涵盖微观、行业、宏观、金融和人口统计序列）。计算所有序列的样本内样本熵和样本外平均绝对缩放误差（MASE），采用统一的单变量预测方法。
AI.findings: 样本熵确实是样本外预测性能的有用预测指标，但受结构突变问题影响。低样本熵（高规律性）与低MASE预测误差正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了熵理论与预测性能的关系，为时间序列可预测性评估提供了理论依据，将信息熵概念与预测误差度量联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议预测从业者采用熵度量，结合成熟的季节性和趋势测试，以更好地理解成功预测结果的可能性。为预测实践提供了实用的先验评估工具。

title: Energy Transition, Distributed Energy Resources, and Flexibility Services: A Systematic Literature Review
affiliations: Universidad EAFIT - School of Economics and Finance - Center for Research in Economic & Finance (CIEF) and

detail.title: Energy Transition, Distributed Energy Resources, and Flexibility Services: A Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: The Paris Agreement's worldwide pledge to keep global warming to 1.5°C has sped up the energy transition, and with this, the deployment of renewable energy sources, increasing the demand for electrical systems' flexibility. To investigate the role of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) in providing flexibility services that support the integration of nonconventional renewable energy (NCRE), this study performs a systematic literature review using the PRISMA approach. DERs enable decentralized, smart grid-based energy models that complement conventional centralized systems. According to the review, which examines 697 papers published between 2010 and February 2024, research has grown exponentially since 2015, especially in Europe. The study examines the functions of emerging agents, such as prosumers, aggregators, and Distribution System Operators (DSOs), and highlights important flexibility services, such as frequency regulation, voltage control, and congestion management, using bibliometric and content analysis. The results show that although DERs greatly improve grid resilience and the integration of renewable energy sources, several institutional, economic, technological, and social barriers prevent their complete implementation. New market mechanisms and regulatory frameworks that promote flexibility and active demand-side participation are needed to address these issues.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PRISMA方法对2010-2024年间的697篇文献进行系统综述，探讨分布式能源资源（DERs）在提供灵活性服务以支持非常规可再生能源（NCRE）整合中的作用。研究发现DERs能显著提升电网韧性和可再生能源整合，但面临制度、经济、技术和社会等多重障碍，需要新的市场机制和监管框架。
AI.research_question: 分布式能源资源（DERs）在提供灵活性服务以支持非常规可再生能源（NCRE）整合中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 《巴黎协定》承诺将全球变暖控制在1.5°C以内，加速了能源转型和可再生能源部署，增加了电力系统对灵活性的需求，需要研究DERs如何提供灵活性服务支持NCRE整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式能源资源（DERs）理论、智能电网理论、灵活性服务理论、能源转型理论、市场机制理论
AI.method: 采用PRISMA方法的系统性文献综述，结合文献计量分析和内容分析，涵盖2010年至2024年2月期间的697篇论文
AI.findings: 1. 自2015年以来相关研究呈指数增长，欧洲尤为突出；2. DERs能够显著提升电网韧性和可再生能源整合；3. 新兴主体（产消者、聚合商、配电系统运营商）发挥重要作用；4. 关键灵活性服务包括频率调节、电压控制和拥堵管理；5. 存在制度、经济、技术和社会等多重障碍阻碍完全实施
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了DERs在灵活性服务提供中的理论框架；2. 识别了新兴主体在能源系统中的角色演变；3. 构建了灵活性服务分类体系；4. 提出了障碍因素分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供促进DERs发展的监管框架建议；2. 为市场设计者提供新的市场机制设计思路；3. 为电网运营商提供灵活性服务实施指南；4. 为能源企业识别发展机遇和挑战

title: Beyond the Actual: The Macroeconomic Implications of the Perceived Taylor Rule
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics

detail.title: Beyond the Actual: The Macroeconomic Implications of the Perceived Taylor Rule
detail.abstract: This paper establishes that the perceived monetary policy rule governs macroeconomic dynamics beyond the actual rule. I first identify a structural “covariance bias” causing downward bias in conventional forecast-based estimates and propose using interest rate nowcasts to recover unbiased perceptions. Through a Restricted Perception Markov-Switching New Keynesian framework, I show that equilibrium determinacy depends not on whether the central bank satisfies the Taylor principle, but on whether agents believe it does. Counterfactual analysis demonstrates that hawkish perceptions were essential for macroeconomic stability during the Great Moderation and the post-COVID inflation surge, highlighting the primacy of the perceived rule.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，市场参与者对货币政策规则的感知（而非实际规则）主导宏观经济动态。通过提出"协方差偏差"问题并使用利率即时预测来获取无偏感知，作者证明均衡确定性取决于市场是否相信央行遵循泰勒原则，而非央行实际是否遵循。反事实分析表明，鹰派感知对"大缓和"时期和疫情后通胀激增的宏观经济稳定至关重要。
AI.research_question: 市场参与者对货币政策规则的感知如何影响宏观经济动态？感知规则与实际规则在决定经济稳定性和均衡确定性方面哪个更重要？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策分析主要关注央行实际遵循的规则，但忽略了市场参与者对规则的感知可能对经济动态产生独立影响。特别是在"大缓和"时期和疫情后通胀激增期间，理解感知规则的作用对于解释宏观经济稳定性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 受限感知马尔可夫转换新凯恩斯框架；2. 泰勒原则；3. 均衡确定性理论；4. 协方差偏差概念；5. 感知规则与实际规则的分离分析。
AI.method: 1. 识别传统预测方法中的"协方差偏差"问题；2. 提出使用利率即时预测来获取无偏的市场感知；3. 构建受限感知马尔可夫转换新凯恩斯模型；4. 进行反事实分析，比较不同感知规则下的宏观经济动态。
AI.findings: 1. 均衡确定性取决于市场参与者是否相信央行遵循泰勒原则，而非央行实际是否遵循；2. 鹰派感知对"大缓和"时期的宏观经济稳定至关重要；3. 鹰派感知同样对疫情后通胀激增期间的稳定起到关键作用；4. 感知规则在决定宏观经济动态方面比实际规则更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"协方差偏差"概念并解决传统估计方法的偏差问题；2. 建立感知规则主导宏观经济动态的理论框架；3. 证明均衡确定性由市场感知而非实际规则决定；4. 将感知规则分析整合到新凯恩斯模型中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行沟通策略提供理论支持，强调建立可信度的重要性；2. 解释历史时期（如"大缓和"和疫情后通胀）的宏观经济稳定性；3. 提供评估市场感知的新方法；4. 对货币政策制定者如何管理市场预期具有重要启示。

title: Governance for Climate Change: International Evidence
affiliations: University of Portsmouth and University of Portsmouth - Portsmouth Business School

detail.title: Governance for Climate Change: International Evidence
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of internal and external governance on the firm's environmental performance in the area of renewable energy. Using an extended global sample of 38,073 firmyear observations, we find that the implementation of climate-related governance controls has positive and significant impacts on firm's renewable energy performance. We also examine the Paris Agreement as an external governance mechanism and find that the positive impact of climate governance is even more substantial for countries joining the Paris Agreement. Our study contributes to the current literature by shedding some light to our understanding of the effect of governance mechanisms in firms' sustainability decisions, by extending our understanding of the mechanism of external and internal governance in the area of renewable energy, by focusing on the effect of CERM and regulators on RE.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了内部和外部治理对公司可再生能源绩效的影响，发现气候相关治理控制对可再生能源绩效有积极显著影响，且巴黎协定作为外部治理机制进一步增强了这种积极影响。
AI.research_question: 内部和外部治理机制如何影响公司在可再生能源领域的绩效？巴黎协定作为外部治理机制是否增强了气候相关治理对可再生能源绩效的积极影响？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化问题日益严峻，企业需要采取可持续行动。然而，目前对治理机制如何影响企业在可再生能源领域决策的理解有限，特别是内部治理（如气候相关控制）和外部治理（如巴黎协定）的相互作用机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论、制度理论和利益相关者理论，研究内部治理机制（气候相关治理控制）和外部治理机制（国际协议如巴黎协定）对企业环境绩效的影响。
AI.method: 使用扩展的全球样本，包含38,073个公司年度观测数据，采用实证分析方法检验气候相关治理控制对可再生能源绩效的影响，并考察巴黎协定作为调节变量的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 气候相关治理控制的实施对公司可再生能源绩效有积极显著影响；2. 巴黎协定作为外部治理机制增强了气候治理的积极影响，加入巴黎协定的国家中这种影响更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对治理机制在企业可持续发展决策中作用的理解；2. 扩展了内部和外部治理在可再生能源领域相互作用机制的理论认识；3. 聚焦于气候相关风险管理和监管对可再生能源的影响机制。

title: Fintech Expansion and Institutional Environment
affiliations: University of Portsmouth - Portsmouth Business School, Nicolaus Copernicus University, Nicolaus Copernicus University and National University of Ireland, Maynooth (NUI Maynooth)

detail.title: Fintech Expansion and Institutional Environment
detail.abstract: The study examines the role of institutional factors in fintech expansion by using Fintech licencing, macroeconomic and bank industry data from 2005 to 2020 in 30 EU and related countries. We found that investors establish fintech companies in countries where environmental uncertainties and resource asymmetries are minimised. The findings indicate that an institutional framework that limits corruption and establishes transparent, accountable and ownershipfriendly regulations, leads to the rapid growth of Fintech companies. Institutional factors keep their decisive role during the period of regulatory transformation and bank crises. We also found that PSD2 regulation that unifies technological and reporting standards has also been accommodating to the fintech sector's growth. The study contributes to current literature and leads to significant policy implications by providing extensive evidence that institutions facilitate the fintech industry's growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2005-2020年30个欧盟及相关国家的金融科技许可、宏观经济和银行业数据，检验了制度因素在金融科技扩张中的作用。研究发现投资者在环境不确定性和资源不对称最小化的国家建立金融科技公司，限制腐败、建立透明、可问责和所有权友好监管的制度框架能促进金融科技快速增长，PSD2法规统一技术标准也有助于行业发展。
AI.research_question: 制度因素在金融科技扩张中扮演什么角色？具体来说，哪些制度特征（如腐败控制、监管透明度、所有权友好政策等）影响金融科技公司的建立和发展？
AI.motivation: 金融科技在全球快速发展，但不同国家间存在显著差异。理解制度环境如何影响金融科技扩张对于政策制定和行业发展至关重要，特别是在欧盟一体化背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论，特别是制度环境对商业活动的影响框架，强调环境不确定性、资源不对称、监管质量等制度因素对企业决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用2005-2020年30个欧盟及相关国家的面板数据，包括金融科技许可数据、宏观经济指标和银行业数据，采用实证分析方法检验制度因素与金融科技扩张的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 投资者倾向于在环境不确定性和资源不对称最小化的国家建立金融科技公司；2. 限制腐败、建立透明、可问责和所有权友好监管的制度框架促进金融科技快速增长；3. 制度因素在监管转型和银行危机期间保持决定性作用；4. PSD2法规统一技术和报告标准有助于金融科技行业发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度理论应用于金融科技领域，扩展了制度环境对新兴技术行业影响的理解；2. 提供了制度因素在金融科技扩张中作用的具体证据；3. 揭示了制度因素在不同经济环境（监管转型、危机时期）中的稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体建议：应建立透明、可问责、所有权友好的监管框架；2. 强调了控制腐败对金融科技发展的重要性；3. 支持PSD2等统一技术标准的监管政策；4. 为投资者提供选址决策参考：关注制度环境质量。

title: How Digital Technology Forms Latecomer Advantage: Evidence from Regional Industrial Leapfrogging in China
affiliations: Tianjin University of Science & Technology

detail.title: How Digital Technology Forms Latecomer Advantage: Evidence from Regional Industrial Leapfrogging in China
detail.abstract: Digital technology is a key driver of industrial development and an essential opportunity for latecomer regions to catch up. This paper constructs a conceptual model of regional industrial leapfrogging to systematically measure and explore how digital technology drives this process, thereby creating competitive advantages for latecomer regions. Theoretically, digital technology can achieve industrial leapfrogging through its platform effects, spillover effects, and network effects. This paper analyzes the role of digital technology in regional economic development, examining how Economic Power by Digital Technology, digital industrialization, and industrial digitalization enable lagging regions to offset deficiencies in their industrial base and achieve industrial leapfrogging. The results indicate that digital technology significantly promotes industrial leapfrogging, with the contribution of industrial digitalization being more substantial. Mechanism analysis reveals that improving resource allocation, enhancing industrial penetration and increasing innovation capacity are key mechanisms by which Economic Power by Digital Technology promotes industrial development. Additionally, the nonlinear relationship between Economic Power by Digital Technology and industrial leapfrogging has been validated. This paper deepens the understanding of the driving factors of Industrial Leapfrogging and the role and mechanisms of the Economic Power by Digital Technology in promoting industrial development.

AI.tldr: 数字技术通过平台效应、溢出效应和网络效应促进后发地区产业跨越式发展，其中产业数字化贡献更大，机制包括改善资源配置、增强产业渗透和提高创新能力。

AI.motivation: 数字技术是产业发展的关键驱动力，为后发地区提供了赶超机会。需要系统研究数字技术如何帮助后发地区克服产业基础薄弱问题，实现产业跨越式发展。

AI.findings: 1. 数字技术显著促进产业跨越式发展；2. 产业数字化的贡献比数字产业化更大；3. 数字经济赋能通过改善资源配置、增强产业渗透和提高创新能力三个机制促进产业发展；4. 数字经济赋能与产业跨越之间存在非线性关系

title: Using Support Vector Regression (SVR) to assess sustainability risk in MENA region
affiliations: University of Portsmouth - Department of Accounting and Finance and University of Portsmouth - Portsmouth Business School

detail.title: Using Support Vector Regression (SVR) to assess sustainability risk in MENA region
detail.abstract: We investigate the complex relationship between sustainability factors and investment decisions, particularly in a financial landscape that is increasingly veering towards sustainability and ethical considerations in the diverse environment of MENA region. The findings reveal that Social sustainability factors are perceived to carry a discernible risk, thereby providing tangible evidence in support of the Social Capital Theory, particularly in relation to social ethics within the region. Our study extends the traditional Fama and French model but also showcases its potential in offering fresh perspectives into the asset pricing domain, by employing support vector regression across a spectrum of kernel functions. Our study therefore, not only contributes to the academic discourse around ESG factors and investment strategies but also navigates through the practical implications and challenges of employing machine learning in financial modelling within the MENA region.

title: Sub-Saharan Africa Is Experiencing a Food-Related Health Risk Problem Within Informal Food Environments: A Need for Urgent Science and Policy Actions
affiliations: University of Waterloo, Sokoine University of Agriculture, Sokoine University of Agriculture, International University of Management, MAVUNOLAB-The Postharvest Innovation Centre, Sokoine University of Agriculture, Makerere University, Ministry of Livestocks, Fisheries and Animal Industries, Africa Rice Center (AfricaRice),  Alliance for Sustainable Development (ASDEV), University of Waterloo, University of Waterloo and International Centre for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT)

detail.title: Sub-Saharan Africa Is Experiencing a Food-Related Health Risk Problem Within Informal Food Environments: A Need for Urgent Science and Policy Actions
detail.abstract: Food-related health risks from unsafe food consumption in informal food environments in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) constitute a growing public health crisis that exposes people to numerous health problems, particularly in areas with limited food safety oversight. Due to low cost, easy access, and convenience, a significant proportion of SSA’s population gets their food from informal food environments, where food safety enforcement and food-related hazards and outbreaks are generally difficult to trace and control. Here, we provide a bird’s-eye view of the different food-related health risk exposures across three critical food value chains, i.e., fruits and vegetables, livestock, and aquatic foods that shape the local food environment in SSA. Identifying and addressing health risk challenges will need investment in research programs that can efficiently characterize food-related health risks within informal food environments, provide data to support economic and health assessment for food-related illness, and most importantly, guide the development and implementation of practical public health interventions that are reflective of the realities and complexities of the local food environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨撒哈拉以南非洲非正式食品环境中与食品相关的健康风险，重点关注水果蔬菜、畜牧和水产三大食品价值链，提出需要投资研究项目来识别风险、提供数据支持，并开发适合当地实际情况的公共卫生干预措施。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲非正式食品环境中，水果蔬菜、畜牧和水产三大食品价值链存在哪些食品相关的健康风险暴露？如何有效识别和应对这些风险？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲非正式食品环境中的食品安全问题构成日益严重的公共卫生危机，由于低成本、易获取和便利性，大量人口依赖非正式食品环境获取食物，但这些环境中的食品安全监管薄弱，食源性疾病难以追踪和控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于食品价值链理论（水果蔬菜、畜牧、水产）和公共卫生风险框架，分析非正式食品环境中的系统性风险暴露。
AI.method: 采用综述性研究方法，对撒哈拉以南非洲非正式食品环境中的三大食品价值链进行系统性分析，提供宏观视角的风险评估。
AI.findings: 非正式食品环境存在严重的食品安全风险，特别是在水果蔬菜、畜牧和水产食品价值链中，这些风险难以追踪和控制，需要系统性的研究和干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对撒哈拉以南非洲非正式食品环境的食品价值链风险分析框架，强调了非正式食品环境在公共卫生风险研究中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别和应对非正式食品环境健康风险的路线图，包括投资研究项目、收集经济健康评估数据、开发适合当地实际情况的公共卫生干预措施。

title: Payment Uniqueness
affiliations: Utah State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Payment Uniqueness
detail.abstract: An agent with a private signal receives a separable payoff in an incentive-compatible mechanism. We prove that the payment is unique if and only if the infimum of the round-trip cost vanishes. Loosely, valuations and allocations cannot jump together. On an interval type space the condition reduces to no common discontinuities. No differentiability is needed. Classical revenue equivalence is a special case. We apply the theorem to the one-insider common-value model of Wilson (1967) and Engelbrecht-Wiggans et al. (1983). In every bid-distribution-symmetric equilibrium, the insider's winning probability is format-invariant. Payment uniqueness then pins down revenue. The proof decomposes revenue equivalence into payment uniqueness and allocation invariance, separating where equivalence holds from where it fails.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在激励相容机制中，当且仅当往返成本的下确界为零时，支付是唯一的。估值和分配不能同时跳跃。在区间类型空间中，条件简化为没有共同的不连续性。经典收益等价定理是特例。应用于Wilson(1967)和Engelbrecht-Wiggans等(1983)的单内部人共同价值模型，证明在投标分布对称均衡中，内部人获胜概率是格式不变的。
AI.research_question: 在激励相容机制中，支付唯一性的充要条件是什么？如何将收益等价分解为支付唯一性和分配不变性？
AI.motivation: 经典收益等价定理通常需要可微性等强假设，本文旨在建立更一般条件下的支付唯一性条件，分离收益等价成立与失效的情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励相容机制设计理论，收益等价定理，拍卖理论，机制设计中的支付唯一性。
AI.method: 理论证明方法，通过分析往返成本的下确界与支付唯一性的关系，建立充要条件。应用于单内部人共同价值模型。
AI.findings: 1. 支付唯一的充要条件是往返成本的下确界为零；2. 估值和分配不能同时跳跃；3. 在区间类型空间中简化为没有共同的不连续性；4. 经典收益等价定理是特例；5. 在单内部人模型中，内部人获胜概率是格式不变的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了支付唯一性的充要条件，无需可微性假设；2. 将收益等价分解为支付唯一性和分配不变性；3. 分离了收益等价成立与失效的情况；4. 扩展了经典收益等价定理的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拍卖设计提供更一般的支付唯一性判断标准；2. 在单内部人共同价值模型中，揭示了内部人获胜概率的格式不变性；3. 有助于理解不同拍卖格式下的收益等价性。

title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Sovereign Risk: New Evidence from U.S. Debt Ceiling Episodes
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Sovereign Risk: New Evidence from U.S. Debt Ceiling Episodes
detail.abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the macroeconomic consequences of sovereign risk. Exploiting high-frequency movements in Treasury prices around U.S. debt ceiling episodes, I construct a novel instrument to identify exogenous shocks to government repayment risk. These shocks generate immediate financial market disruptions and lead to persistent contractions in real economic activity, even in the absence of an actual default. The key transmission operates through the bank-lending channel: Valuation losses on government securities erode bank capital and induce a contraction in credit supply. Investment declines in response, particularly among financially constrained firms, and labor demand falls in capital-intensive sectors, compressing household income and weakening aggregate demand. I interpret these findings through the lens of a DSGE model with nominal rigidities and financial frictions, and use the framework to characterize optimal monetary policy in the presence of sovereign risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国债务上限事件期间国债价格的高频波动，构建了一个识别政府偿付风险外生冲击的新工具。研究发现，即使没有实际违约，这些冲击也会立即引发金融市场动荡，并导致实际经济活动持续收缩。关键传导机制是通过银行信贷渠道：政府证券的估值损失侵蚀银行资本，导致信贷供应收缩。
AI.research_question: 主权风险对宏观经济的具体影响机制是什么？特别是，即使没有实际违约，主权风险冲击如何通过金融渠道传导至实体经济？
AI.motivation: 理解主权风险的宏观经济后果对于政策制定至关重要，但现有研究难以识别外生的主权风险冲击，且对传导机制的认识不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: DSGE模型（具有名义刚性和金融摩擦），强调银行信贷渠道在主权风险传导中的核心作用。
AI.method: 利用美国债务上限事件期间国债价格的高频波动构建工具变量，识别外生的政府偿付风险冲击，并进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 主权风险冲击导致：1）立即的金融市场动荡；2）实际经济活动持续收缩；3）通过银行信贷渠道传导：政府证券估值损失侵蚀银行资本→信贷供应收缩→投资下降（特别是融资约束企业）→资本密集型行业劳动力需求下降→家庭收入压缩→总需求减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了识别主权风险外生冲击的新方法；2）揭示了银行信贷渠道在主权风险传导中的核心作用；3）构建了包含主权风险的DSGE模型框架；4）分析了存在主权风险时的最优货币政策特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者理解主权风险的经济后果提供实证依据；2）强调了维护政府信用对金融稳定和经济增长的重要性；3）为央行在主权风险环境下的货币政策操作提供理论指导。

title: Bank Expansion and Moneylender Interest Rates: RDD Evidence from India
affiliations: Central Bank of Chile, Ghent University, Central European University and University of Illinois

detail.title: Bank Expansion and Moneylender Interest Rates: RDD Evidence from India
detail.abstract: This paper studies how bank expansion affects moneylender interest rates in India, with a focus on distinguishing between competition and adverse selection mechanisms. Using the exogenous variation from the Reserve Bank of India's 2005 Branch Authorisation Policy-which incentivised bank branch openings in districts exceeding the national average population per branch thresholdwe implement a fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design. Treated districts saw 19% lower moneylender rates five to eight years later, robust to borrower wealth, loan characteristics, and credit uptake controls. Heterogeneity analysis shows the effect is driven by short-and medium-term loans-moneylenders' core market. These results point to competition playing a central role, with bank expansion weakening moneylenders' market power and lowering household borrowing costs, while offering limited support for a dominant adverse selection mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了银行扩张如何影响印度放贷人的利率，重点区分了竞争机制和逆向选择机制。利用印度储备银行2005年分行授权政策的外生变化，采用模糊断点回归设计，发现受处理地区放贷人利率降低了19%，且这一效应主要由短期和中期贷款驱动，表明竞争机制起主导作用。
AI.research_question: 银行扩张如何影响印度放贷人的利率？竞争机制和逆向选择机制哪个起主导作用？
AI.motivation: 理解银行扩张对非正规信贷市场的影响机制，特别是区分竞争效应和逆向选择效应，对制定有效的金融包容政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产业组织理论（竞争机制）和信息经济学理论（逆向选择机制），分析银行扩张对非正规信贷市场的双重影响。
AI.method: 采用模糊断点回归设计，利用印度储备银行2005年分行授权政策作为外生冲击，该政策激励在人均银行网点数超过全国平均水平的地区开设银行分支机构。
AI.findings: 1. 受处理地区放贷人利率在5-8年后降低了19%；2. 效应在短期和中期贷款中最为显著，这是放贷人的核心市场；3. 结果对借款人财富、贷款特征和信贷吸收控制变量稳健；4. 竞争机制起主导作用，银行扩张削弱了放贷人的市场势力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为银行扩张对非正规信贷市场的影响提供了因果证据；2. 明确区分了竞争机制和逆向选择机制的作用；3. 丰富了金融包容性政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计金融包容性政策提供实证依据；2. 表明银行扩张可以有效降低非正规信贷市场的借贷成本；3. 帮助理解银行与放贷人之间的市场互动关系。

title: Money, Fast and Slow: New Methods and Evidence on the Paradox of Banknotes
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Money, Fast and Slow: New Methods and Evidence on the Paradox of Banknotes
detail.abstract: This paper provides euro-area evidence on the "paradox of banknotes" – rising circulation amid falling transaction usage –, mitigating the uncertainty surrounding unobservable physical currency flows. We provide a time-series decomposition of euro banknotes in circulation into transactional stocks, foreign holdings, and domestic store-of-value demand. In pharmacology and biology, tracer dyes reveal hidden flows across tissues. Analogously, I identify transactional stocks from the staggered introduction of a new banknote design, which acts as a tracer and motivates a fast-slow diffusion specification rooted in compartmental kinetics. Foreign holdings are estimated with a seasonal method that reduces reference-country sensitivity. The residual domestic store-of-value component is interpreted using survey microdata through a two-stage selection model and tail-calibration techniques assessing plausible underreporting among high hoarders to reconcile micro and macro estimates. Transactional stocks account for 16.5-20% of circulation, foreign holdings for 47-59%, and the residual domestic store-of-value component for around 28% in 2024.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过创新方法分解欧元纸币流通量，解决了"纸币悖论"（流通量上升但交易使用下降），识别出交易存量、国外持有和国内价值储存需求三个组成部分。
AI.research_question: 欧元区纸币流通量如何分解为交易存量、国外持有和国内价值储存需求三个组成部分？
AI.motivation: 解决"纸币悖论"现象——欧元纸币流通量持续上升，但实际交易使用却在下降，这种矛盾现象需要解释，同时需要减少对不可观测的物理货币流动的不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴药理学和生物学中的示踪染料概念，将新纸币设计引入视为"示踪剂"；采用基于隔室动力学的快慢扩散模型；使用两阶段选择模型和尾部校准技术。
AI.method: 1. 利用新纸币设计的交错引入作为示踪剂识别交易存量；2. 使用季节性方法估计国外持有量，减少参考国敏感性；3. 通过调查微观数据和两阶段选择模型分析国内价值储存需求，采用尾部校准技术处理高额囤积者的低报问题。
AI.findings: 2024年欧元纸币流通量分解为：交易存量占16.5-20%，国外持有占47-59%，国内价值储存需求约占28%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将药理学示踪剂概念引入货币流通分析；2. 开发了基于隔室动力学的快慢扩散模型；3. 建立了连接微观调查数据与宏观估计的校准框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行提供了纸币流通结构的量化分解方法；2. 帮助政策制定者理解纸币的实际使用模式；3. 为现金管理政策提供实证依据；4. 减少了对不可观测货币流动的不确定性。

title: Artificial Intelligence: What Drives Adoption in EU Countries?
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence: What Drives Adoption in EU Countries?
detail.abstract: This paper uses results from the 2025 Eurostat's firm-level survey to study the determinants of AI adoption in a cross section of 17 countries and 24 industries of the European Union. We relate adoption to several potential drivers: the perceived obstacles to adoption (as resulting from the survey), the business environment (such as market conditions), the policy context (such as policies directly or indirectly affecting the capabilities and incentives to adopt and use AI technologies) and demography (shares of different age groups within employees). We summarize some of the potential drivers using Principal Components Analysis and take a diff-in-diff approach to regression analysis to highlight how the influence of nationwide drivers of adoption differs depending on industry exposure to them. We find robust statistical associations of first time AI adoption (use of a single AI technology) or extensive AI use (at least three AI technologies) with concerns related to legal uncertainty and ethics or anticipated costs, respectively. Human capabilities (such as ICT skills) and innovation policies are positively related to AI adoption, while policies curbing workforce flexibility or competition in industries that are key providers of intermediate inputs are inversely related to adoption. Finally, we find some evidence of an inverted U-curve between age and AI, with adoption being weaker where the age distribution of the workforce is tilted towards very young or elderly workers. However, AI exposure lessens the negative association between young age and adoption perhaps due to skill-leveling effect of the new technology.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2025年欧盟企业调查数据，分析17个国家24个行业中AI采纳的决定因素，发现法律不确定性、伦理担忧和成本预期是主要障碍，而ICT技能和创新政策促进采纳，劳动力灵活性和竞争限制政策则抑制采纳。年龄分布呈倒U型关系，AI暴露减轻了年轻员工与采纳的负相关。
AI.research_question: 欧盟企业中人工智能采纳的决定因素是什么？哪些因素促进或阻碍企业采纳AI技术？
AI.motivation: 理解AI采纳的驱动因素对于政策制定和企业战略至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对欧盟跨国家、跨行业的系统性分析，特别是对感知障碍、商业环境、政策背景和人口特征的综合考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采纳理论，结合组织创新扩散框架，考察感知障碍（法律不确定性、伦理担忧、成本）、商业环境（市场条件）、政策背景（创新政策、劳动力政策、竞争政策）和人口特征（年龄分布）对AI采纳的影响。
AI.method: 使用2025年Eurostat企业层面调查数据，覆盖欧盟17个国家24个行业。采用主成分分析总结潜在驱动因素，运用双重差分回归分析，考察国家级驱动因素如何因行业暴露程度不同而产生差异化影响。
AI.findings: 1) 首次AI采纳（单一技术）与法律不确定性和伦理担忧相关；2) 广泛AI使用（至少三项技术）与成本预期相关；3) 人力能力（ICT技能）和创新政策促进采纳；4) 限制劳动力灵活性或关键中间投入行业竞争的政策抑制采纳；5) 年龄与AI采纳呈倒U型关系，年轻或年长员工比例过高降低采纳率；6) AI暴露减轻年轻员工与采纳的负相关，可能源于新技术带来的技能均衡效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术采纳理论在AI领域的应用，提出了AI采纳的多维度驱动框架，揭示了政策环境与行业特征的交互作用，发现了年龄分布与AI采纳的非线性关系及其调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性建议：加强法律清晰度、支持技能培训、优化创新政策、避免过度限制劳动力灵活性；为企业管理者提供决策参考：关注员工年龄结构、投资ICT技能、评估成本效益；为行业规划者提供战略指导：考虑行业特征对AI采纳的影响。

title: Evaluating the Limits of Geometric Brownian Motion for Oil Prices: Evidence from Diagnostics and Alternative Models
affiliations: and Columbia University

detail.title: Evaluating the Limits of Geometric Brownian Motion for Oil Prices: Evidence from Diagnostics and Alternative Models
detail.abstract: The Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) model is widely used for asset pricing but may be inadequate for highly volatile commodities like crude oil. This study evaluates GBM's robustness and compares it against GARCH, gradientboosted quantile regression, and MLP neural networks using three decades of WTI crude oil data. Through Monte Carlo simulations and empirical analysis, we demonstrate that violations of constant volatility, not drift variation, drive model breakdown. While GBM performs adequately during stable periods, it systematically under-covers risk during market crises. GARCH models with Student-t innovations maintain reliable coverage in both regimes, offering substantial improvements when risk management matters most. Gradient-boosted quantile regression achieves near-optimal performance, while neural networks underperform due to overfitting. These findings establish that accurate risk estimation depends critically on modeling volatility dynamics, with GARCH-class models essential for crisis-period risk management and machine learning offering promising nonparametric alternatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了GBM模型在原油价格预测中的局限性，发现恒定波动率假设的违反是模型失效的主要原因。相比GBM，GARCH模型在危机期间能提供更可靠的风险覆盖，而机器学习方法中梯度提升分位数回归表现优异，神经网络则因过拟合而表现不佳。
AI.research_question: 几何布朗运动(GBM)模型在高度波动的原油价格预测中的稳健性如何？与GARCH、梯度提升分位数回归和MLP神经网络相比，哪种模型在风险管理和危机期间表现更好？
AI.motivation: GBM模型广泛用于资产定价，但对于原油等高度波动的商品可能不适用。需要评估GBM在危机期间的稳健性，并比较不同模型在风险估计方面的表现，特别是在市场危机时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何布朗运动(GBM)理论、GARCH模型理论、机器学习理论（梯度提升分位数回归和MLP神经网络）、波动率建模理论、风险覆盖理论。
AI.method: 使用30年WTI原油数据，通过蒙特卡洛模拟和实证分析，比较GBM、GARCH（带Student-t创新项）、梯度提升分位数回归和MLP神经网络的表现。
AI.findings: 1. GBM在稳定期表现尚可，但在市场危机期间系统性低估风险；2. 模型失效的主要原因是恒定波动率假设的违反，而非漂移变化；3. 带Student-t创新项的GARCH模型在两个时期都能保持可靠的风险覆盖；4. 梯度提升分位数回归达到接近最优性能；5. 神经网络因过拟合而表现不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了GBM模型失效的根本原因是波动率动态而非漂移变化；2. 建立了波动率动态建模对准确风险估计的关键作用；3. 为GARCH类模型在危机期间风险管理的必要性提供了理论支持；4. 评估了机器学习方法作为非参数替代方案的潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为原油风险管理提供模型选择指导：危机期间应使用GARCH模型；2. 梯度提升分位数回归可作为有效的非参数替代方案；3. 警告GBM在危机期间的风险低估问题；4. 为金融机构和能源公司的风险管理实践提供实证依据。

title: New Echoes of Deep Mexico? Indigenous Identity and Its Enduring Imprints
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE) and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Social Policy and Administration

detail.title: New Echoes of Deep Mexico? Indigenous Identity and Its Enduring Imprints
detail.abstract: This chapter revisits Guillermo Bonfil Batalla's 'México Profundo' (1987) through the lens of contemporary empirical historical economics. In that work, Bonfil Batalla argued that beneath a Westernized facade of modern Mexico lies a "Deep Mexico": a living but denied Indigenous civilization that continues to shape the country's culture, identity, and social life. The first part of the chapter compiles historical census tabulations and harmonized microdata to document persistent patterns of Indigenous identity, inequality, and historical continuity. The historical process of Indigenous identification is multidimensional and endogenous, shaped by language, self-identification, phenotype, and geography. Despite improvements in basic services, Indigenous populations continue to face structural gaps in education and income. Beyond explicit identifiers, the second part of the chapter examines three channels through which 'México Profundo' continues to influence economic life. First, skin tone remains a consistent predictor of disadvantage, reflecting racialized inequality. Second, historical Indigenous presence structures spatial inequality and human-capital outcomes. Third, Indigenous institutions-both formal and informal-continue to shape development trajectories, depending on their interaction with markets and the state. Together, these patterns underscore that 'México Profundo' continues to illuminate key mechanisms linking Indigenous identity to economic and social outcomes in modern Mexico.

AI.tldr: 本文通过当代实证历史经济学视角重新审视Bonfil Batalla的《深墨西哥》理论，使用历史普查数据和微观数据证明墨西哥土著身份、不平等和历史延续性的持久模式，并探讨肤色、历史土著存在和土著制度三个渠道如何持续影响经济生活。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥土著身份如何持续影响当代经济和社会结果？"深墨西哥"理论在当代实证经济学视角下如何解释土著文明对现代墨西哥的持续影响？
AI.motivation: 重新审视Guillermo Bonfil Batalla的《深墨西哥》理论，通过当代实证历史经济学方法验证其关于墨西哥土著文明持续存在的论点，并量化分析土著身份对经济不平等的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Guillermo Bonfil Batalla的"深墨西哥"理论框架，结合历史经济学、身份经济学和制度经济学，分析土著文明对现代墨西哥的持续影响。
AI.method: 使用历史普查数据和协调化微观数据进行实证分析，第一部分量化土著身份、不平等和历史延续性模式；第二部分通过三个渠道（肤色、历史土著存在、土著制度）分析"深墨西哥"对经济生活的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 土著身份识别是多维且内生的，受语言、自我认同、表型和地理因素影响；2. 尽管基本服务改善，土著人口在教育收入和收入方面仍面临结构性差距；3. 肤色是劣势的持续预测因素；4. 历史土著存在塑造空间不平等和人力资本结果；5. 土著制度根据与市场和国家的互动继续影响发展轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将"深墨西哥"理论实证化，为土著文明持续影响提供经验证据；2. 扩展身份经济学在土著研究中的应用；3. 深化对制度延续性和经济不平等机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为墨西哥土著政策提供实证基础；2. 揭示肤色歧视和结构性不平等的持续存在；3. 为理解土著制度与发展互动提供实践启示；4. 为其他多民族国家的土著问题研究提供方法论参考。

title: AI Neutrality
affiliations: and Yale University

detail.title: AI Neutrality
detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence foundation models (FMs) become essential infrastructure for AI applications, concentrated market power and vertical integration create risks of unfair and anticompetitive discrimination. This paper examines how FM providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google increasingly compete with their own customers—the developers building applications atop their models.

Using the case study of Anthropic's termination of Windsurf's API access following acquisition talks with OpenAI, the paper demonstrate how FM providers can exploit gatekeeper positions to favor affiliated applications. The FM market exhibits strong concentration, with the top three providers commanding nearly 90% market share. This enables harmful practices including self-preferencing, service throttling, and bundling arrangements that threaten innovation at the application layer.

Drawing on precedents from telecommunications and other regulated industries, we propose neutrality requirements prohibiting unjust discrimination among similarly situated API customers in pricing, access, and service quality. The paper includes sample legislative language establishing nondiscrimination standards, specific prohibited practices, and transparency requirements. By preventing FM providers from picking winners and losers based on narrow financial interests, neutrality requirements can preserve the competitive AI application market essential to American technological leadership.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨AI基础模型提供商（如Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）如何利用市场支配地位与自己的客户（应用开发者）竞争，通过案例研究展示了不公平竞争行为，并提出建立中立性监管框架以防止歧视性行为。
AI.research_question: AI基础模型提供商如何利用其市场支配地位对应用层开发者进行不公平竞争，以及如何通过监管框架防止这种反竞争行为？
AI.motivation: 随着AI基础模型成为AI应用的关键基础设施，市场集中度和垂直整合加剧了不公平和反竞争歧视的风险。顶级提供商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）占据了近90%的市场份额，并与自己的客户竞争，威胁应用层的创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电信和其他受监管行业的先例，运用平台中立性理论、反垄断理论和市场支配地位滥用理论来分析AI基础模型市场的竞争问题。
AI.method: 案例研究法：以Anthropic终止Windsurf API访问的案例（在Windsurf与OpenAI进行收购谈判后）为例，展示基础模型提供商如何利用守门人地位偏袒关联应用。
AI.findings: AI基础模型市场高度集中，前三大提供商控制近90%市场份额。提供商通过自我优待、服务限流和捆绑安排等有害做法，威胁应用层的创新。这些行为类似于电信行业的反竞争实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台中立性理论扩展到AI基础模型领域，为数字基础设施监管提供新的理论框架。提出了AI基础模型提供商作为"数字守门人"的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的立法建议，包括中立性要求、禁止歧视性定价、访问和服务质量差异的样本立法语言。建立了禁止特定实践和透明度要求的监管框架，以保护AI应用市场的竞争。

title: The Social Risks of Generative AI
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam and VU University Amsterdam

detail.title: The Social Risks of Generative AI
detail.abstract: This paper shows that the equity market prices the novel social risks associated with generative AI. We exploit the release of ChatGPT as an information shock that updated investor beliefs about AI-related tail risks. Using pre-event ESG scores as proxies for firms' social risk management, we show that, controlling for AI productivity exposure, low-ESG firms underperform high-ESG firms by 4 percentage points over the two weeks following the release. The effect is concentrated in the Social pillar, particularly data privacy and security. Increases in option-implied downside risk indicate that changes in discount rates are the channel. A low-minus-high ESG portfolio of AI-exposed firms earns significant alphas during 2023–2024, in line with investors demanding compensation for bearing AI-related downside risks. Our findings are consistent with a tail-risk model in which social risks of AI are priced through discount rates.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，股票市场会对生成式AI带来的新型社会风险进行定价。利用ChatGPT发布作为信息冲击，研究发现低ESG公司在AI相关尾部风险暴露下表现不佳，投资者通过折现率要求风险补偿。
AI.research_question: 股票市场如何对生成式AI带来的新型社会风险进行定价？投资者是否要求对AI相关的尾部风险进行补偿？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（如ChatGPT）的兴起带来了新的社会风险（数据隐私、安全等），这些风险可能影响公司价值。传统上，ESG评分用于衡量公司社会风险管理能力，但AI带来的新型风险是否被市场定价尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尾部风险定价理论：投资者对AI相关的社会风险（特别是尾部风险）要求风险补偿，这些风险通过折现率影响公司估值。ESG评分作为社会风险管理能力的代理变量。
AI.method: 事件研究法：以ChatGPT发布作为外生冲击，比较不同ESG评分公司在事件后的股票表现。使用AI生产力暴露作为控制变量，分析ESG评分（特别是社会支柱）与股票回报的关系。使用期权隐含下行风险衡量折现率变化。
AI.findings: 1. 在ChatGPT发布后两周内，低ESG公司比高ESG公司表现差4个百分点；2. 效应主要集中在社会支柱，特别是数据隐私和安全方面；3. 期权隐含下行风险增加表明折现率变化是主要渠道；4. 2023-2024年间，AI暴露公司的低减高ESG组合获得显著alpha，表明投资者要求AI相关下行风险补偿。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将尾部风险定价理论扩展到AI社会风险领域；2. 证明ESG评分在AI时代的新价值：衡量公司应对AI社会风险的能力；3. 提出AI社会风险通过折现率影响公司估值的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供新的投资策略：关注AI暴露公司的ESG表现；2. 为公司管理者提供启示：需要加强AI相关的社会风险管理；3. 为监管者提供参考：AI社会风险已反映在市场定价中，需要相应监管框架。

title: Data Centers’ Environmental Sustainability in the EU
affiliations: University of Padova - "Marco Fanno" Department of Economics and Management, University of Padua, University of Padua and University of Padova, Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Data Centers’ Environmental Sustainability in the EU

declarations.funderStatement: Ministry of Universities and Research (MUR) of Italy, European Union — Next Generation EU, Mission 4 Component 1, CUP C53D23004950006, PRIN2022 project ‘The Geography of the Twin Transition: mapping the regional combination of the green and digital transition — GEOTWIN’.

detail.abstract: The Twin Transition (TT henceforth) — the simultaneous advancement of digitalisation and environmental sustainability — has become a cornerstone of European Union policy, underpinning the European Green Deal, the Digital Decade policy programme and Cohesion Policy objectives (European Commission, 2022; Barbero et al., 2025; Fernandez et al., 2021). Digital infrastructures are expected to act as key enablers of decarbonisation, resource efficiency and innovation, for example by supporting smart grids, industrial automation and data-driven optimisation of energy and transport systems (Gao, 2025; Veugelers et al., 2023). At the same time, the rapid expansion of these infrastructures raises growing concerns regarding energy demand, greenhouse gas emissions, water use, critical raw materials and territorial inequalities (Commins & Irion, 2025; European Commission, 2025a; Stacciarini & Gonçalves, 2025).

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了数字基础设施在双转型（数字化与环保可持续性同步推进）中的双重角色：既是实现脱碳、资源效率和创新的关键推动者，又因其快速扩张带来能源需求、温室气体排放、水资源使用、关键原材料消耗和地区不平等等环境与社会挑战。
AI.research_question: 数字基础设施在双转型中扮演着怎样的双重角色？它们如何既作为环保可持续性的推动者，又成为环境和社会挑战的来源？
AI.motivation: 双转型已成为欧盟政策的核心支柱，但数字基础设施的快速扩张引发了对其环境影响的担忧。需要平衡数字技术作为环保推动者的潜力与其自身扩张带来的环境和社会成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双转型理论、可持续发展理论、数字基础设施的环境影响评估框架、资源效率与创新理论。
AI.method: 政策文献分析、案例研究（智能电网、工业自动化、能源和交通系统优化）、环境影响评估、欧盟政策文件分析。
AI.findings: 数字基础设施在支持智能电网、工业自动化和数据驱动优化方面确实能促进脱碳和资源效率，但它们的快速扩张也显著增加了能源需求、温室气体排放、水资源使用、关键原材料消耗，并加剧了地区不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字基础设施在双转型中的双重角色理论框架，深化了对技术作为解决方案和问题来源双重性的理解，为可持续发展与数字化的整合提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了平衡数字基础设施发展与环境保护的实践指导，提出了在推进数字化的同时最小化环境和社会成本的策略建议，有助于实现更可持续的双转型路径。

title: Regime-Aware Risk Management in Concentrated Equity Portfolios: Evidence from the Magnificent Seven

detail.title: Regime-Aware Risk Management in Concentrated Equity Portfolios: Evidence from the Magnificent Seven
detail.abstract: This study evaluates whether a transparent, regime-aware momentum framework can improve risk control within highly concentrated equity portfolios. Using the "Magnificent Seven" U.S. equities (Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta Platforms, NVIDIA, and Tesla), we implement a monthly, rules-based strategy that integrates multi-horizon momentum selection with a macro regime filter based on Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS). Rather than seeking return amplification, the framework is designed to mitigate drawdowns while maintaining participation in long-term equity growth. Strategy performance is evaluated relative to passive buy-and-hold allocations to the same equities and broad market benchmarks. Results indicate that regime-aware exposure materially reduces maximum drawdown and enhances risk-adjusted performance relative to passive benchmarks, while accepting potential opportunity costs during prolonged uninterrupted bull markets. These findings suggest that macro-regime filters traditionally applied at the asset-class level may also enhance risk management in concentrated portfolios of individual equities when evaluated across full market cycles.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了一个透明、基于宏观周期的动量框架是否能改善高度集中股票投资组合的风险控制。使用"七巨头"美国股票，实施月度规则化策略，将多时间跨度动量选择与基于TIPS的宏观周期过滤器结合。该框架旨在减轻回撤，同时保持对长期股票增长的参与，而非追求收益放大。
AI.research_question: 透明、基于宏观周期的动量框架能否改善高度集中股票投资组合的风险控制？
AI.motivation: 高度集中的股票投资组合（如"七巨头"）虽然可能带来高回报，但也面临显著的回撤风险。传统的宏观周期过滤器通常应用于资产类别层面，但较少研究其在个股集中投资组合中的应用效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动量投资理论、宏观周期投资理论、风险管理理论、行为金融学中的损失规避理论
AI.method: 使用"七巨头"美国股票（苹果、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet、Meta、英伟达、特斯拉），实施月度规则化策略，结合多时间跨度动量选择与基于TIPS的宏观周期过滤器，并与被动买入持有策略和广泛市场基准进行比较
AI.findings: 基于宏观周期的暴露显著降低了最大回撤，相对于被动基准提高了风险调整后绩效，但在长期不间断牛市中可能接受潜在机会成本
AI.theory_contributions: 将宏观周期过滤器从资产类别层面扩展到个股集中投资组合的风险管理，验证了跨市场周期的评估方法在集中投资组合中的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为集中股票投资组合提供了实用的风险管理框架，帮助投资者在保持长期增长参与的同时控制回撤风险，特别是在"七巨头"等高集中度投资组合中

title: Original Sin Revisited: US Military Hegemony and Corporate Dollarization
affiliations: Northwestern University, Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: Original Sin Revisited: US Military Hegemony and Corporate Dollarization
detail.abstract: Why do firms in some countries borrow heavily in U.S. dollars while others rely on local-currency debt? This paper develops a geopolitical theory of corporate dollarisation. I argue that the U.S. security umbrella—the system of security guarantees and military assistance extended to allied nations—acts as state-contingent fiscal insurance that lowers enforcement risk and reduces the perceived tail risk of foreign-currency liabilities. When U.S. security provision strengthens, dollar funding becomes cheaper and safer for firms in aligned economies, increasing their private incentives to borrow in dollars and to expand leverage. However, this geopolitical insurance creates corporate moral hazard. As firms collectively increase dollar borrowing, aggregate exposure to dollar funding conditions rises and systemic vulnerability increases, an effect individual firms do not internalize. Foreign-currency borrowing can therefore be privately optimal yet socially excessive. I show that a state-contingent tax on dollar borrowing, complemented by capital controls that dampen the pass-through from dollar issuance to funding conditions, can implement the socially optimal currency composition of corporate debt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了企业美元化的地缘政治理论，认为美国安全保护伞通过降低执行风险和尾部风险感知，使盟国企业更倾向于借入美元债务，但这会导致企业道德风险和系统性脆弱性，需要政策干预实现社会最优债务货币构成。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同国家的企业在美元债务和本币债务选择上存在差异？美国安全保护伞如何影响企业美元化决策？企业美元化如何产生私人最优但社会过度的结果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要从宏观经济和金融角度解释企业美元化，但忽视了地缘政治因素的作用。本文旨在填补这一空白，探讨美国安全保护伞如何作为国家或有财政保险影响企业债务货币选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治企业美元化理论：将美国安全保护伞视为国家或有财政保险，降低执行风险和尾部风险感知；企业道德风险理论；系统性脆弱性理论；私人最优与社会最优的偏离。
AI.method: 理论模型构建：分析美国安全保护伞如何影响企业美元债务决策；识别私人激励与社会最优的偏离；提出政策干预方案（或有美元借款税和资本管制）。
AI.findings: 美国安全保护伞降低了企业美元借款的成本和风险，增加了企业美元借款和杠杆扩张的私人激励；但导致企业道德风险和系统性脆弱性；企业美元化可能是私人最优但社会过度的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业美元化的地缘政治理论；将安全保护伞概念化为国家或有财政保险；建立了私人最优与社会最优偏离的分析框架；为理解国际金融与地缘政治的交叉提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了实现社会最优企业债务货币构成的干预政策：或有美元借款税和资本管制；为政策制定者管理美元化风险和系统性脆弱性提供了工具；有助于平衡私人激励与社会福利。
